description: Call this tool to convert a sheet between excel (xlsx), csv and json. Writes a new file next to the source unless out_path is given; the source is never modified. Returns the new file path with its row and column counts.

out_path.description: Where to write; default is the source name with the new extension, next to the source. It must differ from the source path

path.description: Path to the source .xlsx/.xlsm/.xlsb/.ods/.csv/.tsv file (~ is expanded); it is never modified

sheet.description: Sheet to convert; default is the first sheet. Only that one sheet is written

to.description: Target format; the default out_path takes this as its extension

name: sheet_convert
title: Convert file
